reborn-0497.rationale: Dice Jar's two wordings encode the same outcome: reroll ties; otherwise the lower roller takes the higher roll x500 when the winning roll is 2-5, or 6000 when the winning roll is 6. The pinned Lua directly implements those branches for both players.

reborn-1352.rationale: The old display text spells out face-up WATER monsters while the current text says WATER monsters you control; a face-down monster does not present an Attribute for this continuous field modifier. The flip-trigger portion is the same return-to-hand effect. Pinned Lua applies +200 ATK to controlled WATER monsters in the Monster Zone and targets exactly one opponent-controlled card on EVENT_FLIP to return it to the hand.

reborn-1546.rationale: Both texts trigger when a roid monster you controlled is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY, then optionally return that monster to its owner's hand. The engine text's requirement that Rescueroid remain face-up to activate/resolve is inherent in its field-trigger effect and is enforced by the Lua's LOCATION_MZONE range and relation check. Duel.SendtoHand with no receiving player returns the card to its owner.
